OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
To help users effectively prevent fraud risks in daily trading and enhance account security, Gate P2P has officially launched the "Safety Shield Program." Complete the safety course and knowledge quiz to enter the lucky draw—100% winning on draws, with up to 1 GT up for grabs.
## Campaign Period: November 19, 2026, 10:00 – December 4, 2026, 15:59 (UTC)
Join Now
## I. How to Participate
## 1. Learn the Safety Course & Score 100% on the Quiz to Win a Draw
Read through the Mastering P2P Trading: A Beginner's Guide to Safe Transactions course to master essential anti-fraud skills, such as preventing third-party payment scams and spotting fake payment proofs.
Take the safety quiz and score 100% (answer all questions correctly) to earn 1 lucky draw entry.
100% winning on draws, with a top prize of 1 GT. Rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis.
## 2. Account Security Upgrade Bonus
Visit your Security Settings to check your current safety score.
Complete your security configurations to reach a score of 80+ to activate Gate Security Guard, adding an extra layer of protection to your assets and unlocking exclusive subsidies.
## 3. Safe Trading Practice
Complete at least 1 P2P buy order of ≥ 100 USDT safely during the campaign period to earn 1 lucky draw entry.
## II. Terms and Conditions
Token rewards will be distributed to eligible winning accounts that pass risk control reviews within 14 business days after the campaign ends;
Voucher rewards will be automatically distributed to eligible winning accounts that pass risk control reviews. For instructions on using Dual Investment Trial Funds, please refer to the Dual Investment Trial Fund User Guide;
Campaign rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis for daily draws;
We will regularly collect user feedback to continuously optimize our products and services;
Gate reserves the right to amend the terms and conditions of this campaign without prior notice;
According to our User Agreement, this service is not available to users in the UK and other restricted regions. Users who fail to meet the eligibility criteria will be disqualified from receiving rewards.
